The Chief Risk Officer (CRO) is responsible for establishing and overseeing the risk management framework for the firm's exchange and clearing operations conducted in or from ADGM. The role provides independent oversight of risks impacting market integrity, clearing and settlement activities, liquidity, operational resilience, and the overall stability of the exchange and clearing ecosystem.
q: Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Finance, Economics, Accounting, Law, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Significant experience in risk management within exchanges, clearing houses, capital markets, financial market infrastructure providers, or virtual asset businesses.
Strong understanding of ADGM regulatory requirements, including Market Infrastructure Rules and financial market infrastructure risk principles.
Experience overseeing market, clearing, settlement, liquidity, collateral, or operational resilience risk frameworks.
Experience engaging with regulators, Boards, and senior stakeholders.
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Strategic thinker with strong commercial judgement and sound risk management expertise.
Able to provide independent challenge while balancing innovation, growth, and market integrity.
Demonstrates high integrity, accountability, and professionalism.
Comfortable operating within a highly regulated and systemically important environment.
Passion for financial markets, digital assets, and emerging technologies.
Embraces the use of AI and technology to enhance risk monitoring, surveillance, stress testing, and operational resilience.
r: li
Develop, implement, and maintain the risk management framework in accordance with applicable FSRA Rules, FSMR, and Market Infrastructure Rules (MIR).
li
Oversee risk governance processes covering market, clearing and settlement, liquidity, collateral, operational resilience, technology, cyber security, outsourcing, and systemic risks.
li
Monitor the overall risk profile of the exchange and clearing operations and ensure material risks are managed within approved risk appetite.
li
Oversee frameworks relating to margin methodologies, collateral management, liquidity monitoring, stress testing, and default management.
li
Provide independent risk oversight and challenge over exchange operations, clearing activities, market structure changes, participant onboarding, and new products.
li
Conduct stress testing, scenario analysis, reverse stress testing, and recovery planning exercises to assess the resilience of the market infrastructure.
li
Assess risks relating to market abuse, participant exposures, operational disruptions, and systemic events.
li
Oversee the development and maintenance of risk policies, procedures, risk indicators, and reporting frameworks.
li
Prepare regular risk reports for the Board, Risk Committee, and senior management.
li
Liaise with the FSRA on risk management matters, regulatory reviews, inspections, and supervisory engagements.
li
Promote a culture of risk awareness, market integrity, and operational resilience across the organisation.

d: As Drilling Solution Engineer within NOV’s you will be responsible for providing technical support and expertise in drilling operations. You will work closely with clients, drilling engineers, and other team members to ensure the successful execution of drilling projects. Your role will involve analyzing and optimizing drilling solutions to maximize operational efficiency and safety.
q: Bachelor’s degree in petroleum engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
Strong knowledge of drilling fundamentals, including drilling techniques, drilling fluids, wellbore stability, and drilling equipment.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in Drilling or a related role in the oil and gas industry.
Experience with drilling optimization, including the selection of drilling parameters and drilling fluid properties.
Basic understanding of drilling rig components, including drill bits, drill string, and drilling fluids.
Familiarity with drilling practices, such as rotary drilling, mud circulation, and well control.
Ability to interpret drilling data, such as drilling parameters and wellbore conditions.
Proficiency in basic wellbore stability analysis and drilling fluid properties.
Proficiency in utilizing and customizing advanced drilling software applications, such as real-time monitoring systems, drilling optimization algorithms, and data analytics platforms.
Familiarity with drilling software applications for hydraulics analysis and torque and drag modelling.
r: li
Collaborate with clients to understand their drilling objectives and develop appropriate drilling solutions.
li
Conduct engineering analysis to optimize drilling parameters, such as weight on bit, drilling fluid properties, and drill string configurations.
li
Monitor drilling operations in real-time and provide technical support to drilling teams on the rig.
li
Perform post-well analysis to evaluate drilling performance and identify areas for improvement.
li
Develop and maintain technical documentation, including drilling reports, procedures, and best practices.
li

Collaborate closely with clients, drilling supervisors, and multidisciplinary teams to assess drilling objectives, provide technical expertise, and develop comprehensive drilling plans and strategies.
li
Utilize advanced drilling software applications and data analytics to optimize drilling parameters, minimize risk, and maximize operational efficiency.
li
Monitor real-time drilling operations, analyzing data and performance indicators to identify opportunities for improvement and make necessary adjustments to enhance drilling performance.
li
Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory developments in drilling operations, incorporating relevant advancements into project planning and execution.
li

Prepare and deliver high-quality technical reports, presentations, and documentation to clients, management, and industry conferences, showcasing innovative drilling solutions and successful project outcomes.

d: We are seeking a forward-thinking, analytical, and results-oriented Strategic Planning Manager to lead the development, evaluation, and execution of organizational strategies that support sustainable business growth and long-term success.

The ideal candidate will possess strong strategic thinking, business analysis, project management, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive strategic initiatives and measure their impact on overall business performance.
Develop and implement short-term and long-term strategic plans aligned with organizational vision, mission, and business objectives.
Conduct market research, industry analysis, competitor benchmarking, and business intelligence to identify growth opportunities.

Support organizational transformation, change management, and business improvement initiatives.

Ensure effective communication and alignment of strategic objectives across all organizational levels.
